purpose: Precise alias -> canonical source basename mapping to prevent duplicate DOI entries and maintain evidence traceability.
rules: Use exact knowledge/sources/<canonical_key>.md basename as BibTeX key.
Never create multiple BibTeX entries sharing the same DOI under different aliases.
Keep book identities (Casten 1990, Heyde 1999, BM Vol. 1) strictly distinct from review/journal articles (Heyde & Wood 2011 RMP).
